lines.t: Yeah, listen.
I've been staring at the wounds, let the memories talk.
False knees on my back, had me chained to walk.
Coping like a junkie with the pain in my chest.
But the letters here hard, put the lies to the test.
He said, confess your heart, so I hear need.
So I bleed on the page, let the practice see.
No more idols in my head, no more image of a fraud.
I want Yahushua as he is, not the God I thought was God.
I was swallowing the pain just to look like a man
Now I'm breaking in his presence with my face in my hands
He said, seek my heart, boy, let the coping all die
So I drag it to the light, let the macho pride fry
Kill the false need, face the heart, let it cry
Day to die, let the macho pride fry
Real strength is to break, let the will resign
And rise in his word, hardcore in his design
I'm a man in the furnace, every secret exposed
Takin' ownership of sin, every door I had closed
Daily cycle on repeat, where the darkness was bred
Now his word is the blade, cuttin' cords in my head
I ain't chasin' at the women just to know what I feel
I ain't starvin' for approval, I'm consumed by what's real
My meat is the will of my father, that's the creed
If I got him, I got life, every other need bleed
I was thirsty for the praise, now I'm hungry for the flame
Let him brand my whole soul with his covenant name
If the crowd fall back, I'ma still stand firm
Let the fear die slow while the trust unlearned
Kill the false we need, face the heart, let it cry
Daily die, let the macho pride frown
Real strength is to break, let the will resign
And rise in his word, hardcore in his design
Every morning, same war, same choice, same cross
On every single sin, stop countin' the cost
Let the heart speak raw, let the old man choke
When the letters cut deep, let the flesh go broke
If he strips my supports, I'ma bless that vein
If he shakes my house, I'ma praise in the rain
Super masculine stance, but the need still bend
Cause the strongest man snaps when the letters descend
And he said, seek my face only, trust must be
The kind you never known, it's a gift from me
The kind that comes from knowing, I am he
So I drop my reputation, let the ego flee
No more tough guy front, when the panic hit hard
I just quote what he wrote, let it tear me apart
Out the darkness, out the land, where the dead men roam
I be walking through the valley, but my eyes on home
If he calls me to be single, then I'll walk that lane
If he calls me to a household, I'ma serve in the strain
Either way, I'm unchanged from the desperate crave
Cause the only real need died and walked out the grave
Feel the pulse in me, face the heart, let it cry
Let it die, let the macho pride fry
Real strength is to break, let the will resign
Then rise as in his word, hardcore in his design
I've been to the bottom where the silence screams
Where the man in the mirror just fractures at the seams
He said, bring me that heart, don't polish that mess
Don't hide those motors, don't fake that stress
So I spit it like a storm, every lust, every fear
Every twisted little vow, they've been driving my gear
When the anger comes back, I don't flex, I confess
When the shame try to choke, I just call him blessed
He the fire in my bones, he the steel in my spine
Not a soft little idol, he's a war front line
If the world bows out, I'ma still declare
That Yahushua is the king and he answered my prayer
Feel the pulse in me, face the heart, let it cry
Daily die, let the macho pride fry
Real strength is to break, let the will resign
And rise in his word, hardcore in his design
Yeah, this that hardcore trust when the storm don't quit
When the tables pull back and he's thinning the pit
I'ma stand in the cut while the old knees burn
Every day, same fire, same lesson to learn
If my bread is his will, then I'll gladly be starved
Let the flesh grow weak while the spirit stay hard
No cap, no match, just a man undone
Face down, hands up in the light of the sun
Kill the false me
Kill the false me
Kill the false me
Let it cry
